import asyncio as aio
import time
from asgiref.sync import sync_to_async as wrap


def local_work(value):
    time.sleep(0)
    return value


async def stored(items):
    wrapped = wrap(local_work)
    await wrapped(1)
    await wrapped(2)
    return (wrapped(x) for x in items)


async def offloaded():
    await aio.to_thread(local_work, 1)
    await aio.to_thread(local_work(2))


async def shadowed(wrap):
    wrapped = wrap(local_work)
    await wrapped()


async def unresolved(client):
    client.wait()
